expected_behavior_change: Normal Safari/browser sessions no longer treat equal Rxx as proof that local Admin state matches Cloud canonical state.
Canonical hydration compares publishedAt, adminFingerprint and canonical fingerprint instead of revision equality.
Canonical hydration keeps release/outbox ordering time-first rather than revision-first.
Keeta Admin requests do not remain permanently stuck on an expired/stale browser session; one existing Admin session refresh is attempted after 401 and the request is retried once.
Private mode and normal mode use the same canonical Admin and Keeta authorization semantics.
non_goals: No OAuth reauthorization, unbind/rebind, secret rotation or new provider account.
